LightningComponentBundle.description: Renders a Google Maps pin from configurable address fields. Works on any object.

property.name: streetField
property.label: Street Field API Name
property.description: API name of the street field (e.g. Site_Street__c)

property.name: cityField
property.label: City Field API Name
property.description: API name of the city field (e.g. Site_City__c)

property.name: stateField
property.label: State Field API Name
property.description: API name of the state field (e.g. Site_State__c)

property.name: postalCodeField
property.label: Postal Code Field API Name
property.description: API name of the postal code field (e.g. Site_Postal_Code__c)

property.name: mapTitle
property.label: Card Title

property.name: mapHeight
property.label: Map Height (px)
